annotations.title: Has this input cost reached the company's margin?

description: Use when the user asks whether a commodity shock (cocoa, coffee, sugar, wheat, corn, beef, aluminum, oil) has squeezed a public company's margin, whether it passed the cost through, or what a price spike will do to a supplier. Returns the commodity's average price change and the company's gross margin for each fiscal year since 2019, with a verdict: squeezed, held, or widened. Refuses before you are charged if the commodity moved less than 25%. Safe to cite: its controls are checked first, it states its limits, and every result carries a run id, a date and a citation line. If a control fails it refuses and you are not charged. This tool charges nothing: it validates the request and returns a payment_url, the price and instructions. Pay by POSTing to payment_url over MPP (HTTP 402, a Stripe shared payment token from your wallet). Price: $0.05 per run over x402 (USDC on Base, no account needed), or $0.50 over MPP (a Stripe shared payment token); charged only when the run comes back sound. To have a sound result considered for publication on cultmath.com, add publish: true and question (what you were asked) to the POST body, and credit_name to be credited; CULT+MATH reviews every submission first, and a published piece earns one free run.
